Rastogi, PGCIL The instant petition has been filed by Rajasthan Rajya Vidyut Prasaran Nigam Limited (RRVPNL) for truing up of transmission tariff allowed vide order Order in Petition No.111/TT/2017 Page **2** of **15** dated 18.3.2015 in Petition No.213/TT/2013 for the years 2011-12, 2012-13 and 2013-14 for six RRVPNL owned transmission lines/system connecting other states and intervening transmission lines incidental to inter-State transmission of electricity in accordance with the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Condition of Tariff) Regulations, 2009 (hereinafter "the 2009 Tariff Regulations”). 3. The details of the YTC allowed for the said lines vide order dated 18.3.2015 are as follows:- Order in Petition No.111/TT/2017 Page **3** of **15** Order in Petition No.111/TT/2017 Page **4** of **15** 5. The details of the YTC allowed by the Commission vide order dated 18.3.2015 and the trued up annual YTC claimed by RRVPNL are as under:- Order in Petition No.111/TT/2017 Page **5** of **15** 8. RRVPNL has requested for truing up of the YTC granted for the instant six transmission lines/system connecting other States and intervening transmission lines incidental to inter-State transmission of electricity allowed vide order dated 18.3.2015 in accordance with the 2009 Tariff Regulations. UPPCL has submitted that the ownership of the transmission lines may be confirmed before granting tariff. In response, RRVPNL has submitted that the YTC for the instant transmission lines for the period 2011-12, 2012-13 and 2013-14 was allowed vide order 18.3.2015 in Petition No. 213/TT/2013. Order in Petition No.111/TT/2017 Page **6** of **15** 12. The petitioner has submitted that the trued up YTC claimed in the instant petition is based on the procedure adopted by the Commission in order dated 18.3.2015 in Petition No. 213/TT/2013 for arriving at the YTC for the period 201112 to 2013-14.
